about: Live corpus of VisTest: part of a page a fraction of a pixel off, and real changes of the same photos. Written by `python scripts/live_corpus.py --regenerate`; do not edit.

capture.stability: frames until two in a row are byte-identical, 5000 ms limit

control: every frame drawn in two browsers started the same way; 0 pixels apart, or the capture stops
storage: lossless WebP; the pixels of the PNG the capture returned

split.rule: by template: history is for calibration; gallery is held out — it never takes part in choosing a threshold or any other constant of the engine, and is measured once a choice has been made on history

spent.gallery: 2026-10-14, v13 attempt 1 (the rule «a picture drawn a fraction of a pixel over»): measured once after the choice on history — 6 of 6 false failures and a new miss (image_tint/de4); rolled back. A second attempt is measured on a template drawn after this date
spent.feed: 2026-10-15, v13 attempt 2 (the rule «a raster picture drawn a fraction of a pixel over»), the acceptance narrowed to pictures by the maintainer before it was measured: image_shift 0 of 3 false failures, but a new miss (image_crop/plus4px — a large smooth photo whose crop moved by 4 px reads as noise once blurred); rolled back

labels.SIGNAL: the page changed; a tool must fail
labels.NOISE: nobody changed the page; a tool must pass

history.title: a list of trips with rounded photo thumbnails

gallery.title: a grid of large rounded photos, captions, badges, a dark header

feed.title: a social feed: a large rounded photo in a post, round avatars, a column of thumbnails

inbox.title: a mail list: senders, subjects, snippets, middle dots, initials in round avatars — text only
